links.outcome: Authenticity of references provided by ChatGPT-3 in radiology answers
links.effect: Of 343 references, 124 (36.2%) were available via internet search; 219 (63.8%) appeared generated by ChatGPT-3. Only 47 of 124 identified references (37.9%) gave enough background to answer 24 questions (37.5%).
links.quote: Out of 343 references provided, only 124 references (36.2%) were available through internet search, while 219 references (63.8%) appeared to be generated by ChatGPT-3.

links.outcome: Correctness of ChatGPT-3 answers to radiology questions versus peer-reviewed references
links.effect: 59 of 88 responses (67%) were correct; 29 (33%) contained errors.
links.quote: A total of 59 of 88 responses (67%) to radiological questions were correct, while 29 responses (33%) had errors.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy and hallucination of citations across 88 radiology questions without testing a specific safeguard or deployment practice.
